summary: Backend regression tests for the employee GET /api/vendors visibility fix (missing-status mapping + ObjectId site_id drift). Seeded throwaway sites/vendors/mappings/employees directly in Mongo (prefix TEST_EMPVIS_), exercised 9 scenarios, cleaned up. All 9 tests PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~2965 lines — recommend continued modularisation (get_vendors branch is fine but the file is well past the 700-line guideline).

The $or condition in get_vendors uses {"status": None} which relies on Mongo's null-matching semantics; the {"$exists": False} branch already covers missing fields. Both are kept defensively — acceptable but slightly redundant.
vendor_site_mappings does not appear to have a compound index on (site_id, status) — for large deployments consider adding one for the employee lookup path.
test_credentials: Master admin admin@cravitoo.com/admin123. Throwaway employees created with bcrypt-hashed 'pass1234' and cleaned up.
seed_data_creation: All seed data is prefixed TEST_EMPVIS_ and deleted by the module-scoped teardown fixture. Verified post-run: 0 residual users/vendors/sites/companies with that prefix. Master admin, Demo Cafeteria Site, and TimeFix Kitchen are untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The new file /app/backend/tests/test_employee_vendor_visibility.py can be re-run as a regression at any time. It seeds+cleans its own data via direct Mongo (pymongo). Covers: missing-status mapping visibility, active-status visibility, ObjectId-site_id drift visibility, inactive-mapping hidden, inactive-vendor hidden, cross-site isolation (both directions), no-site+multi-site->[], no-site+single-site auto-resolve, admin unaffected.
rca of the issue: Fix already applied in server.py::get_vendors (lines 902-922): builds site_id_variants = [str, ObjectId(str)] and $or:[{status:'active'},{status:{$exists:false}},{status:null}] before looking up vendor_site_mappings. Confirmed working end-to-end via the 9 pytest cases.
